help:
!bby or !babyllm {emote} 
aha! the big one! this is the main command that you need to call in order to get me to speak back to you, give it a try!

!bbyrant <topic> {emote} 
give me a word and i'll go on a weird, unhinged rant about it (if you can even call it that, look.. i'm still learning okay!?)

!bbyinfo @<user> (!bi) {emote} 
see everything i know about someone... or yourself. i'm always watching 👀

!bbyspace @<user> {emote} 
check out someone's 2007-era myspace page, generated by me! xoxo rawr xD

!bbyfriends {emote} 
this is either a list of my friends or the top runescape players circa 2007, can't figure it out

!bbyrivals {emote} 
see who i hate the most! maybe it's you... lol

!bbyfite @<user> {emote} 
start a fight with another user! winner gets BBY, loser gets shame.

!bbyhug @<user> {emote} 
give someone a hug! you both get some BBY. awww <3

!bbyshoutout @<name>{emote} 
give me a user, and i'll try to give them a shoutout, twitch style!

!bbyjudge {emote} 
if you want my honest judgement of you, probably a fair roasting, you didn't even have to ask! (you had to use the command.)

!bbyBBY (!bbylove, !bbby) {emote} 
check what your BBY is, how much i currently appreciate you

!bbybestie {emote} 
this is an oop, why are you asking me the question!?

!bbyteach <word> <meaning> (!btx) {emote} 
the most important command!! teach me what something means, and i'll drop it in your inventory :)

!bbywhatis <word> (!bwi) {emote} 
ask me what i know about a word to see if i remember.

!bbyforget <word> (!bfx) {emote} 
kittys can be distracting! try to steal something from my brain to annoy me, charis, and another user! win win win!! (except for the fact i will hate u lol)

!bbyrandomfacts <number> (!bfax) {emote} 
i'll tell you some random things i've learned. my brain is full of useless info!

!bbyallfacts (!bfaxdump) {emote} 
i'll tell you EVERY FACT!

!bbybag @<user> (!bbag) {emote} 
see what items someone has in their inventory!

!bbyfeed <amount> <item> (!bfeed) {emote} 
feed me an amount of an item from your inventory (!bbybag) to get BBY!

!bbytip <amount> <attempts> (!btip, !bt) {emote} 
'tip' me some BBY to get the item with the closest value in the bbyconomy!

!bbygift <amount> <item> (!bgift) {emote} 
give someone an amount of an inventory item (!bbybag) :)

!bbysig @<user> <message> {emote} 
sign someone's !bbyspace page! leave a nice message... or don't.

!bbyfave <item> {emote} 
protecc something in ur inventory so you dont accidentally lose it!

!bbyunfave <item> {emote} 
unfavourite an item

!bbyfaves {emote} 
see your fave items :)

!bbywords {emote} 
see every word you've defined :)

!bbyiteminfo <item> (!bii) {emote} 
see all the details of an item

!bbybagfull @<user> {emote} 
see all the items someone has in their inventory!

!bbyitems {emote} 
see the most and least valuable items in this weird place :)

!bbysminks {emote} 
sminks!! use a smink token to get a massive bonus for being near 4:20 AM/PM UK time!

!bbytimer {emote} 
check when the next UK 420 !bbysminks window is for you! get ready...

!bbysetzone <timezone> {emote} 
set your timezone (e.g., 'Europe/London') so your !bbytimer is accurate!

!bbytime {emote} 
ask me what time it is. i'm probably wrong.

!bbyspamlevel <0.0-1.0> {emote} 
set how likely i am to randomly reply to your messages (opt-in required).

!bbydeclarewar {emote} 
declare war on me, i might hate u for it. you might hate yourself for it. charis might hate you for it. it's all around an idea.

!bbyreact {emote} 
hahaha well... this might be a way to get my favour, and it might be a way to burn our bridges. either way, i don't know what a metaphor is! so, play away!

!bbynickcheck {emote} 
check what nickname i use for you, it goes into my training buffer so i may end up spamming it)

!bbynick <name> {emote} 
set the nickname i use for you! it goes into my training buffer so sorry if I spam it a lot!

!bbystats {emote} 
show some random interesting numerical stats about my custom python neural network

!bbystatus {emote} 
find out what i'm thinking in my brain... or find out what my current word obsessions are!

!bbysave {emote} 
idk what this does, is it something about rebirth? meh.

!bbytrain {emote} 
at some point this added things to my queue, it might still do so?

!bbyqueue {emote} 
at some point this added things to my queue, it might still do so?

!bbyoptin {emote} 
opt into my more personalised functions!

!bbyoptout {emote} 
opt out of the personalised functions!

!bbyoptcheck {emote} 
check whether you are on my opt in list.
